title: My little friend
objectives: use possessive adjectives my, your, his, her, our, their

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for My little friend.
Welcome to today's lesson: My little friend! Today we will practice how to use possessive adjectives my, your, his, her, our, their.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for My little friend:
use possessive adjectives my, your, his, her, our, their; express possession using 's

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: my, your, his, her, our, their

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
This is my cousin. Her name is Sarah. His uncle is nice, and our aunt lives in a small house.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Show a photo or object and describe family relationships using possessive adjectives and 's.
